summary: Capital Southwest Corp. filed an 8-K to disclose the Sixth Amendment to its equity distribution agreements, increasing the ATM program cap from $1.0 billion to $2.0 billion. As of the filing, approximately $1.1 billion remains available for sale. Jefferies, Raymond James, Citizens JMP, and B. Riley serve as sales agents. This is a routine amendment to an existing at-the-market offering facility, not a special situation event.
